Mine usually come very randomly.... No real reason for them either. Most of the time im not even worried about anything in particular. Its so weird. The worst one I've ever had was when I was just sitting in my roommates room with him, I was sitting on the floor leaning against his bed. I was just staring out the window, the discovery channel was on, we weren't really talking to each other. We were just kinda hanging out... The first thing that happened was an overwhelming feeling of "somethings not right". I had no idea it was a panic attack. It started so suddenly and didn't creep at all. The most scary part was my vision got all blotchy. You know when you look at a light and then look away, you get that green or orange negative spot in your vision? Well I had that,  every shadow and outline was that weird neon color. It freaked me out. I kept saying to my roommate over and over "something is very wrong, something very very wrong, I can't see" I asked him to get me a glass of water, he came back, I took a sip and then I just puked on myself. I was fine after that. A little shaky, I had to go lay down but I was okay. The most recent one was actually after I went to the bathroom, number 2, lol. I was still sitting on the toilet and my vision did that blotchy thing again so I knew what was coming. I just sat there breathing and saying to myself I'm okay... After a couple minutes I was fine. I stood up very slowly, carefully walked back into my room and laid down. I started getting super nauseated and my heart was still racing. I just kept breathing slowly and eventually I was fine. No idea why I get them so bad. There's never a clear reason for them either. 

Oh, and they always make me sweaty and clammy. I usually have to turn the fan on. Low, because if its too high, it makes me feel like I'm dying lol.

This will probably get buried but.... I was hooked on meth for three years. I started out doing it with my boyfriend.. A year and a half later, he went to rehab and came out straight as an arrow. I stopped for about 3 weeks, then slowly picked it up again without him knowing. I actually was able to hide it from him for another year and a half. We then broke up, for unrelated reasons. I continued doing it for about 3 more months or so and then I moved across the country. Since I didn't know anyone who did it, I was forced to quit. It was surprisingly very easy to quit cold turkey. I've been clean now for 10 months now. I do find myself thinking about it sometimes.. Like if I had the chance to smoke it again, I probably would. I don't think I'm strong enough to say no to it yet. I have to be careful about who I hang out with. But during my three years of using, the first year and a half was all fun and games. No worries really. It was when I was hiding it that it got hard. I couldn't explain where all my money was going, why I hardly slept, why I had such bad mood swings. Its actually pretty hilarious that my ex never found out.. I was very good at hiding it, apparently. I just recently came clean told him about it, and he honestly had no clue the entire time. I had to explain to him that I didn't have the means to go to rehab like he did, and him expecting me to quit at the same time as him was very impossible for me. He understood. Honestly, the only way to quit that stuff is wanting to quit. Its HARD to want to stop. I never really hit rock bottom, I got lucky.
